text: Cobee Cooks was four years old.
Atlanta police found him during a welfare check at a townhome on Cardinal Drive. Arrest warrants obtained by WSB say his body was in a closet, under a pile of clothes.

text: The Fulton County Medical Examiner ruled his death a homicide, from multiple blunt-force injuries.

text: Two women, Jasmaine Smoak and Jasmine Jenkins, are charged with murder and child cruelty. Those are charges, not convictions.

text: His grandparents told WSB that his father called child protective services and police when he saw bruises on his boys, and that the agency found nothing wrong. Cobee's five-year-old brother is now in the hospital.
